text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training with <chrname>.
I sent her off to rest first while I tidied up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So the next person can use them comfortably,
I'll clean thoroughly,
and reorganize the attachments by weight...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You. How long do you plan to stand there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning around, I saw Orfevre
standing tall with her arms akimbo. Judging by her stance, she was just about
to begin her training, but――
choice_data_list: Are you gonna use this machine, by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Incapable of wrapping up on schedule, are you?
How sluggish.
choice_data_list: I'll clean it up right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the next reservation time had arrived
before we realized it. In a hurry, I rearranged the attachments,
reset the machine's settings, and...ââ

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You have wasted several minutes of We's time.
Surely you have an adequate reason for such conduct?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A crackling, terrifying intimidation washed over me. ...It felt as though anything I said would sound like a mere excuse, but――
choice_data_list: Just wanted to make sure it's smooth for the next person to use.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The attachments are ordered by weight.
The settings are restored to their default values. Small details, perhaps, but I believe they lead to comfort.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: M-Maybe I spoke out of turn...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Indeed, you're sharp.
That was a thoughtful gesture.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her head over to the training machine...
sweat pours down all at once. Released from the intense tension,
I let out an involuntary sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought having every corner tidied up neatly
would make it far more pleasant for the next person using it.
I didn't want to cut corners on something like that...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: I-I'm sorry for being so slow...
I-I'm sorry, I'm just so slow...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Continue to uphold such devotion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator

I let out an involuntary sigh of relief.
